caption: The drawing depicts a weather vane consisting of a horizontal arrow with a silhouette of a human figure blowing a horn and wearing a hat, mounted vertically on a post. The figure is positioned as if running, with one leg raised and bent at the knee. The weather vane sits on top of a spherical base that rests on a square plinth with sloping sides. The entire structure appears to be rendered in shades of green and brown, suggesting a patina, likely representing aged metal such as copper. At the top left corner of the drawing, there is a small inset diagram with measurement annotations, showing a simplified outline of the weather vane and its components. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color, and a fine border encloses the entire image.
title: Weather Vane
